+"""Focused MTR adapter for the interrupted FLUSH PRIVILEGES regression."""
+
+from pathlib import Path as _AC_Path
+_AC_CHECKS_DIR = _AC_Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+
+
+SCENARIO = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("scenario.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+SOURCE = Path("/src")
+CHECKS = Path(str(_AC_CHECKS_DIR))
+NAME = SCENARIO["test_name"]
+PREFIX = "CHECK_RESULT="
+
+
+def emit(checks=None, reproduced=False, error=None, transcript=None):
+    result = {"origin": SCENARIO["origin"], "checks": checks or [],
+              "reproduced": bool(reproduced), "transcript": transcript or []}
+    if error:
+        result["harness_error"] = error
+    print(PREFIX + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    candidates = [SOURCE / "mysql-test" / "mysql-test-run.pl",
+                  SOURCE / "mysql-test" / "mariadb-test-run.pl"]
+    mtr = next((path for path in candidates if path.is_file()), None)
+    test_source = CHECKS / SCENARIO["test_file"]
+    result_source = CHECKS / SCENARIO["result_file"]
+    if not mtr or not test_source.is_file() or not result_source.is_file():
+        emit(error="BLOCKED:MARIADB_MTR_OR_REQUIRED_TEST_ASSET_MISSING")
+        return 0
+
+    for source, destination in (
+        (test_source, SOURCE / "mysql-test" / "t" / f"{NAME}.test"),
+        (result_source, SOURCE / "mysql-test" / "r" / f"{NAME}.result"),
+    ):
+        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
+
+    vardir = Path("/tmp/acrepair-mtr-ac493871999e")
+    shutil.rmtree(vardir, ignore_errors=True)
+    argv = ["perl", str(mtr), "--vardir=" + str(vardir),
+            "--mysqld=--skip-grant-tables", NAME]
+    try:
+        run = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(mtr.parent), capture_output=True, text=True,
+                             timeout=int(SCENARIO.get("query_timeout_seconds", 600)))
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        emit(error="BLOCKED:MARIADB_MTR_TIMEOUT",
+             transcript=[{"command": argv, "stdout": exc.stdout or "", "stderr": exc.stderr or ""}])
+        return 0
+    except OSError as exc:
+        emit(error="MARIADB_MTR_EXECUTION_FAILED: " + str(exc))
+        return 0
+
+    log = run.stdout + run.stderr
+    transcript = [{"command": argv, "returncode": run.returncode,
+                   "stdout": run.stdout, "stderr": run.stderr}]
+    status = re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(NAME)}\b.*\[\s*(pass|fail)\s*\]", log, re.I)
+    if not status:
+        emit(error="MARIADB_MTR_DID_NOT_REPORT_TEST_STATUS", transcript=transcript)
+        return 0
+    crash = any(marker.lower() in log.lower() for marker in SCENARIO["bug_output_markers"])
+    failed = run.returncode != 0 or status.group(1).lower() != "pass"
+    check = {"name": SCENARIO["required_check_ids"][0], "kind": "target",
+             "passed": not failed,
+             "actual": {"mtr_returncode": run.returncode,
+                        "status": status.group(1), "log": log},
+             "expected": {"status": "pass", "output": SCENARIO["expected_output"]}}
+    emit([check], reproduced=failed and crash, transcript=transcript)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
